@@ -15,7 +15,7 @@ SUDO=$(command -v sudo || true)
 
 PACKAGES="$@"
 
-PKG_MANAGER_PATH=$({ command -v apk || command -v apt || command -v dnf || command -v yum || command -v zypper || command -v pacman; })
+PKG_MANAGER_PATH=$({ command -v apk || command -v apt || command -v dnf || command -v yum || command -v zypper || command -v pacman || command -v eopkg-cli; })
 
 # /usr/bin/dnf -> dnf
 PKG_MANAGER=${PKG_MANAGER_PATH##*/}
@@ -33,6 +33,10 @@ dnf)
 	$SUDO dnf -y install $PACKAGES
 	;;
 
+eopkg-cli)
+	$SUDO eopkg-cli -y install $PACKAGES
+	;;
+
 pacman)
 	$SUDO pacman -Sy --noconfirm $PACKAGES
 	;;
